simplifiedNote: D-012 exploration content (left ice route, lava-tube sub-map). Positions, minutes, points and rewards are game values for pacing, not measurements. The lava tube is fictional: known Mars skylights/possible caves are on Arsia Mons (Tharsis), not at the landing sites in this game.

cave.scaleNote: The tube uses the surface scale (gameplay.metersPerPixel), so walking speed, jumping and the metres-per-game-minute rule are identical inside and outside.
cave.roomSpanNote: Fictional chamber width (game value). Real Arsia Mons skylight openings are about 100-225 m across.

skylight.note: Mars Odyssey THEMIS: from day to night the Arsia Mons skylight's temperature changes only about one third as much as the surrounding surface. Game model (simplified): deep reading = diurnal mean + (current surface - mean) x this fraction.

cave.vibrationNote: Synthetic, relative amplitudes (no unit) for an interpretation exercise: one point rings differently, which needs more data; it never proves the chamber is safe.
